openings.claim: Replace shared picking with small, pattern-specific local batches whose material counts reconcile before envelopes are sealed.
openings.delta: Each volunteer stages exact quantities for a bounded batch in a separate table zone, fills its envelopes, and reconciles leftovers and envelope contents immediately. Pencil pattern identifiers on exteriors support correct assignment.
openings.prediction: At matched pattern mixtures, local batches reduce shared-material omissions and crossing reaches; reconciliation catches filling errors before distribution.
openings.rival_prediction: The nearest alternative is shared-tray assembly with immediate checking. If late checking causes the problem, both approaches improve accuracy equally, while local staging adds time.
openings.defeat: Matched batches retain the same omission rate or staging plus reconciliation consumes the time saved by fewer reaches.
openings.probe: Within the existing two-volunteer session, compare two six-kit batches with matched pattern counts, one local and one shared. Include staging and checking in elapsed time; tally omissions before correction and reaches. Keep all materials within marked table zones and count the probe toward the 90-minute limit.
assumptions: Local staging fits the existing table; its usable footprint is unconfirmed.
The bounded comparison does not establish all 60 kits can meet the deadline.

openings.claim: Demand-based supply preflight can prevent avoidable replenishment interruptions without opening every packet simultaneously.
openings.delta: Before picking, total required sheets by pattern and colour on the existing tally sheet; account for unopened stock and identify the next packet to open when a tray runs low.
openings.prediction: Verified reserve locations allow replenishment before a colour shortage interrupts filling.
openings.rival_prediction: Reactive replenishment may be equally fast if finding the unopened packet takes negligible time; preflight then adds overhead.
openings.defeat: Counting and reserve identification cost more time than the shortage interruption they prevent.
openings.probe: Time preflight and replenishment within the 90-minute assembly budget, keeping unopened packets stored until needed. Record any shortage-induced pause.
assumptions: Sufficient quantities and dimensions across all supplies remain unverified.
Fit concerns the bounded probe; deadline improvement remains unproven.
